correctness.rationale: For any finite field F_q of characteristic p>5 and all a,b, translation x→x−a/5 sends the two fixed top coefficients to B=b−2a²/5 while bijectively reparametrizing free c,d. Inclusion–exclusion over fibers of quintic degree <=5 reduces the mean image count to q−(q choose 2)/q + ((q choose 3)−K4(B)+K5(B))/q². Four equal evaluations correspond exactly to quadratic Q+s²=-2B; five additionally impose s=0 and Q=-2B. Distinct input constraints are removed by explicit partition-lattice Mobius weights; for p>5 all indicated quadratic forms are nonsingular, so standard Gauss representation formulas give exact B=0/nonzero squareclasses. The squareclass difference is (qχ(5)−χ(-15))/(3q²) !=0. Independent direct enumeration of ALL q² free coefficient pairs for EACH B over F7 and F11 checked each exact rational formula; e.g. F7 q²-scaled totals B=0:229, nonzero squares:225, nonsquares:227. Analytic proof, not finite checks, establishes all extension fields and p>5.
